message.content: Logistic regression is a statistical technique used for binary classification problems. It models the probability that a given input belongs to one of two classes (e.g., success/failure, yes/no) by fitting a logistic function to the data. The model estimates the log‑odds of the outcome as a linear combination of the input features, and then applies the logistic (sigmoid) function to convert those log‑odds into probabilities between 0 and 1.
